protocol.training_standardization: Common mixture of dataset pair, number of t<100 samples in the two-sample batch, and scene dropout. Full 1000-update blocks determine weights. This does not control every diffusion t or noise realization; observation clean/noisy realization is not recorded per training batch.
protocol.validation_aggregation: Use raw validation.jsonl summary count-weighted metrics. Foot-monitor summaries are equal-case means, stored separately. Fixed and rotating panels never pooled.
protocol.old55k_comparison: Not attempted: legacy native20Hz differs in architecture/protocol from current native30Hz; raw total loss scales are not interchangeable.

interpretation.learning: Training loss still improves. Latest 10k fixed pose error is 192.5/208.1 mm clean/noisy vs 210.8/205.6 mm at 9k. Fixed validation fluctuates; the 9k rebound after 8k is retained in the record.
remaining_risks: Only three fixed VAL windows; no full held-out benchmark conclusion.
Latest root orientation error 35.8/37.9 degrees and MPJPE 192.5/208.1 mm remain large; noise robustness is unstable.
Latest body-local foot error 309.5/322.9 mm and GT-stance foot speed 0.298/0.344 m/s are not yet satisfactory.
Dataset behavior differs. TRUMANS, EgoBody and RICH must be reported separately rather than only an aggregate best step.
Rotating windows change each validation; curve fluctuations do not isolate learning progress.
interpretation.recommendation: Keep the existing authorized continuous baseline running; assess later fixed-window motion/heading/feet with same seeds and true 3D visuals. Current data supports continued learning but cannot promise that 55k will reproduce legacy quality. Ground penetration is not quantified by MPJPE or foot speed; assess signed foot-to-support distance separately before choosing a correction.
